metadata.title: Retro Pop Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-key studio portrait of a smiling woman with voluminous curly hair, framed by vertical blue gradient bars and featuring a signature-style script overlay in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's warm skin tones and brown hair contrast against the cool blue sidebars.
The white tank top acts as a central brightness anchor, connecting to the white script text.
The verticality of the sidebars stabilizes the organic, wild texture of the subject's hair.
coreInvariants: High-volume, textured hair as a primary silhouette feature

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, medium shot from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the smile, move up to the hair, then to the script in the top left, and finally down the vertical blue bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the flat grey background around the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey background and white clothing provide a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue gradients on the left and right edges create a frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm browns and deep berry lip color provide organic warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) center with saturated blue accents on the periphery.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive handwriting with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: Rapid, fluid strokes mimicking a felt-tip marker
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated ascenders and descenders
Angled upwards from left to right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter is oversized and integrated with a geometric block element
Terminal strokes end in sharp, tapered points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the expressive script with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for metadata to ground the composition.
graphicDevices: Distressed geometric block behind the first letter
Vertical gradient bars on the left and right edges

avoid: Heavy block fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the personal, 'autograph' feel of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with large, curly 80s-style hair and a white tank top against a grey background, flanked by two vertical blue gradient bars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a white, hand-drawn signature-style script in the top left corner, angled slightly upward, with a small distressed black square behind the first letter.

verificationChecks: Is the script legible but expressive?
Are the blue bars perfectly vertical and symmetrical?
Is the lighting on the subject high-key and even?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Any specific brand logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the blue gradients are smooth without banding.
Verify the white tank top is not blown out (retains texture).
Confirm the hair silhouette is crisp against the grey background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Vertical Gradient Frames + Signature Overlay
